item.title: DriverChecker - Find Malicious Drivers on a System
item.description:
I’m proud to introduce DriverChecker, a tool that will scan all loaded drivers on a system for any that may be suspicious/malicious in nature! This blog post will supplement the GitHub repository for the tool, outlining the various modules that the tool uses to try to detect any potentially suspicious drivers. The GitHub repository can be found here.
